title: New maglev line opens between Tokyo and Nagoya
description: The first commercial segment begins passenger service after years of tunneling delays.

title: Winter Arts Festival takes over Rio's waterfront
description: Open-air concerts and light installations run along Copacabana through the weekend.

title: The Roman Forum
description: Center of public life in ancient Rome for over a millennium; ruins of temples, basilicas, and arches remain.

title: Brief power outage hits Lower Manhattan
description: A substation fault cut power to several blocks for about an hour during the evening rush.

title: Berlin summer half-marathon route announced
description: Organizers publish a course through Mitte and the Tiergarten for next month's race.

title: Great Pyramid of Giza
description: The oldest of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World and the only one largely intact.

title: Nairobi fintech hub announces expansion
description: A cluster of payment startups plans new offices, adding hundreds of engineering jobs.

title: Harbour light show returns to Sydney
description: Projection art lights up the Opera House sails for the annual winter event.

title: The Acropolis of Athens
description: Citadel crowned by the Parthenon, symbol of classical Greece and Athenian democracy.

title: Rally over rail fares outside Westminster
description: Commuters gathered to protest a proposed increase; traffic was briefly diverted.

title: Monsoon food fair opens in Mumbai
description: Street-food stalls and cooking demos run under cover near Marine Drive.

title: The Great Wall at Badaling
description: The most-visited restored section of the Great Wall, north of Beijing.

title: Record fog blankets San Francisco Bay
description: A dense marine layer delayed morning ferries and grounded a few flights.

title: Aurora viewing nights begin near Reykjavik
description: Guided evening tours resume as darker skies return to southwest Iceland.

title: Teotihuacan
description: Vast pre-Columbian city with the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon, northeast of Mexico City.
